Chapter 5994: Not Someone

Chapter 5994: Not Someone

Li Qiye’s expression turned serious as he stopped drinking and appeared before her.

He immediately tore her robe off, revealing two proud, radiant snow lotuses blossoming with red pistils.

“What are you doing?!” She became startled and covered her breasts.

However, his eyes were on her wound alone; its condition worsened. Cracks imbued with the yang affinity spread from the wound.

“What injured you?” He asked.

“Someone.” She could see he had no intention of disrespecting her.

“Not someone.” He said before placing his palm on her breasts.

She was startled but didn’t stop him. Sure enough, his hand released light seeping into the wound.

Lightning bolts with a black glow appeared as a reaction to his primordial light, being forced to stop their invasion. They had no place to hide and eventually, attempted to escape.

He was faster and caught all of them, pressing his palms together and turning them into a single pond of lightning.

When taking a closer look, each drop of water seemed to contain black lightning bolts. This black power was different from darkness and didn’t seem to be evil. It appeared to be a punishment, delivered to suppress or seal something.

“Buzz.” Li Qiye sent more primordial rays into the black ocean, peeling out this unknown affinity.

“Boom!” The ocean erupted and a heavenly tribulation manifested into reality.

The woman was strong but she trembled, feeling her body breaking down. The black bolts contained a power beyond comprehension.

For example, the high heaven didn’t allow anyone or anything to comprehend its power and secrets. Punishments and tribulations descended once violated.

The black bolts seemed to have something like it as well. They tried to explode but his primordial power forcefully calmed them down.

“Pop!” The tribulation power was forced back into the miniature ocean and he continued the separating process, removing the black bolts from the source.

They roared like primal beasts between his palms, wanting to devour him and his primordial power along with the rest of the world.

Unfortunately, it couldn’t break free from his grasp and was reduced to nothingness.

“Rumble!” His destruction of the bolts caused a reaction from the deepest crevices above. However, they couldn’t descend to this area.

Nevertheless, the woman noticed their presence above and became frightened.

Li Qiye, on the other hand, didn’t bother looking up at the imposing gathering. His focus was on the leftover entity - a drop of water that was no longer infected by the unknown affinity.

It contained a boundless life force attuned to nature. It wasn’t cultivated through cultivation nor was something similar to a sprout turning into a sky-blotting tree with time.

It resembled something that had been there before the creation of the world itself - an inborn force granted by the heaven. It could bring someone back from the brink of death and give them another chance at life.

This was the mythical phenomenon of reincarnation in the truest sense, not methods of emperors or ancestors clinging to life since they still had some left.

Li Qiye focused his gaze for another full analysis, attempting to derive and understand them. After numerous deviation cycles, he finally understood the meanings of life contained within the drop.

“Everyone dozes off at times.” Li Qiye looked up at the high heaven and sighed.

The woman didn’t understand his comment while he infused the drop of water into her wound.

“Zzz.” The water of life seeped inside and healed her wound instantly.
